children: According to ChainCatcher, Initia said on Nov. 9 that it is investigating an issue affecting Rollup infrastructure and coordinated with the relevant Rollups to pause them temporarily. The team has not identified any impact on user funds and hopes block production will resume soon. Initia’s L1 remains online, though some services, including the Initia Scan block explorer, are experiencing degraded performance.

title: Initia Coordinates Temporary Rollup Pause, Reports No User Funds Affected
